newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower in thin trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended lower in thin trading due to lack of buying interest from the small investors before market closed for Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 7.76 points or 0.67 percent to 1,140.26 on a turnover of 35.4 million taka. Of the 125 issues traded 75 lost, 46 gained and five unchanged.
Brokers said investors were watching the market after few big market players and company executives had been implicated for involvement in share price manipulation late last year.
Apex Foods fell 37.38 to 2,011.44 and Beximco Pharma lost 1.76 to 136.97.
